do_not_change.summary: Preserve the provider-conditional, single-statement Signal insert and Postgres parent-row locking behavior.
do_not_change.evidence: The supplied verification records a migrated Postgres 16 regression using the production repository and withPgClient path: a terminal UPDATE holds the run row lock, the Signal insert blocks, then re-evaluates terminal status and no-ops. FOR SHARE conflicts with the terminal UPDATE lock and is held through the autocommit statement.
do_not_change.impact: Replacing this with an unlocked read-then-insert path would reintroduce terminal-run Signal races.
do_not_change.recommendation: Retain the provider guard so D1 keeps its supported atomic INSERT…SELECT form while Postgres retains FOR SHARE.

do_not_change.summary: Preserve the composite project/run foreign key, provider-cost integer-storage guard, and immutable Signal retry semantics.
do_not_change.evidence: Verification documents migration-backed SQLite coverage for fractional-cost rejection, null/zero/integer preservation, composite tenancy rejection, cascade behavior, and immutable retry/drift handling; the full Postgres migration tree and gated repository test also passed.
do_not_change.impact: Removing any of these controls would weaken cross-provider parity, tenancy integrity, or historical Signal immutability.
do_not_change.recommendation: Keep these constraints and their focused regression tests intact.
